changes.beforeContent:
def total_price(prices, tax_rate)
  subtotal = 0.0
  prices.each do |price|
    subtotal += price
  end
  subtotal + subtotal * tax_rate
end
changes.afterContent:
def order_total(prices, tax_rate)
  subtotal = 0.0
  prices.each do |price|
    subtotal += price
  end
  subtotal + subtotal * tax_rate
end
